[[File:Singing_Mountain_Sister.jpg|thumb|right|250px|A [[Singing Mountain Clan]] sister]]
{{Quote|I will take you to my clan, and all of my sisters will witness that I have caught you fairly.|[[Teneniel Djo]] to [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]]|<ref name="copl">''[[The Courtship of Princess Leia]]''</ref>}}
'''Sister''' was a title given to all junior members of the [[Witches of Dathomir]] society, including the dissident covens known as the [[Nightsisters/Legends|Nightsisters]].

==Usage==
{{Quote|Tell me, Sister Leia, are people always trying to kill you?|[[Augwynne Djo]] to [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]]|<ref name="copl" />}}
On the obscure [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]], the title of "Sister" was used, regardless of actual kinship, as a form of address for a [[Witch/Legends|witch]], alone or followed by her first name.<ref name="copl" /><ref name="TBoS">''[[Book of Sith: Secrets from the Dark Side]]''</ref><ref name="TCWNS">{{TCW|Nightsisters (episode)}}</ref> Sometimes, this title was also applied to offworlders, out of affection or respect&mdash;[[Augwynne Djo]] once called [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] "Sister Leia".<ref name="copl" />

The first [[Dathomirian/Legends|Dathomiri]] witches were all biological sisters, born to the wayward [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Allya/Legends|Allya]],<ref name="copl" /> whence the metaphorical use of "Sister" amongst them. Additionally, the sisters referred to their leader as "[[Mother (title)/Legends|Mother]]," further developing the metaphor of the family.<ref name="TCWNS" />

==Behind the scenes==
This title first appeared in [[April]] [[1994]] in [[Dave Wolverton]]'s ''[[The Courtship of Princess Leia]]'', where it was extensively used, with variants such as "clan sister", "sisterhood" and "Nightsister".<ref name="copl" />

The use of both "Sister" and "Mother" as forms of address is similar to what happens in the hierarchy of [http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nun Roman Catholic nuns].
